goal: Build a table of headline quarterly results for S&P 500 companies from their own earnings press releases: revenue, net income and diluted earnings per share for the quarter just reported. Every figure carries the sentence or table row it came from, so anyone can check it in two seconds.

criteria.text: Every value in a proposal is backed by a quote that appears word for word in the press release and contains that value at the precision it was written.

The figures agree with each other and with the filing: net income never exceeds revenue, EPS carries the sign of net income, the stated growth matches the two revenue figures within one point, and the period ends at most 120 days before the filing date.
A proposal has exactly the fields of the proposal shape, correctly typed, with amounts in whole US dollars, and its key is not already merged.

guidelines: Prefer GAAP figures over adjusted or non-GAAP ones when a release gives both.
Prefer the quarter just ended over year-to-date, nine-month, trailing or full-year figures.
Never estimate or derive a missing number. Leave the field null and give no quote for it.
Convert every amount to whole US dollars. A table row headed in millions is multiplied out; a per-share figure stays as written.
If the release gives two GAAP figures for the same item (restated, revised, a range), ask instead of choosing.
outOfScope: Guidance, outlook and forecasts for future quarters.
Non-GAAP and adjusted measures, margins and ratios.
Segment, product, regional and customer breakdowns.
Balance sheet and cash flow items, dividends and buybacks.
Any ranking, comparison, recommendation or investment opinion.
Companies with no press release in the input folder.

proposalShape.periodEnd: <ISO date, last day of the quarter>
proposalShape.netIncome: <integer, whole US dollars, negative for a loss, or null>
proposalShape.revenueChangePct: <number, negative for a decline, or null>
